scenarios.name: baseline
scenarios.description: No interventions. Full ship + flight + destination network with inferred parameters.

scenarios.description: All ship passengers isolated in cabins from day 1; only household contacts retained.

scenarios.name: enhanced_destination_protocols
scenarios.description: All evacuees tested + isolated upon arrival; destination contacts effectively contained.
